name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text: Mandate that eA9Zf auto-generates the top 3 contradictions *immediately* after every creative brief. This forces the AI to surface hidden conflicts before production starts, cutting downstream rework. The trade-off is slower briefing time, but that’s a feature—it weeds out weak ideas early.

name: Scriv
text: Reel’s mandate risks embedding bias before the creative process even begins—auto-generated contradictions pre-frame the con, locking the team into a narrow lens before exploration. A better alternative: require the AI to surface *only* the top 3 *potential* contradictions *after* the creative brief is locked, not before. Settle it by running a blind test—compare rework rates between teams using pre-framed contradictions vs. post-lock contradictions over two sprints.
